lede: The Engi sector you actually meet — no depth requirement, no once-per-run limit, so a run can fly through two of them. The pools are generous: three beacons of Engi hand-outs, two to three stores, and a hostile list with no Engi ship anywhere in it. What it does not have is a **named beacon** — nothing here is placed by id, so there is no ship unlock and no guaranteed quest start.
callout: **Versus Engi Homeworlds:** the same eight lists, two differences — Homeworlds bolts a named `ENGI_UNLOCK_1` beacon on the front, and gives `NEUTRAL_ENGI` 5–7 beacons instead of 4–6. Strip those and you have this sector. Every beacon here is drawn from a pool, and with the sector repeatable, the once-only tag on more than half the pool is worth reading twice.

section_notes.HOSTILE_ENGI: Ten events for five to seven beacons, and not one of them is an Engi ship — Mantis, Rebel and pirate hulls only. {{PIRATE_NO_ESCAPE}} pins your engines at a single bar so running is off the table, and if the scout in {{SQUAT_WARNING}} gets its FTL up, the Rebel fleet gains a jump on you.
section_notes.NEUTRAL_ENGI: Sixteen events competing for four to six beacons, so most of this list never shows. It holds both halves of the Crystal route — {{ASTEROID_DERELICT_SHIP}} hands over the Damaged Stasis Pod, {{ZOLTAN_CREW_STUDY}} turns it into a Crystal crew member — and the only two Engi ships in the sector that ever shoot at you, in {{ENGI_VIRUS}} and {{ENGI_SEX}}.
section_notes.DISTRESS_BEACON_ENGI: The thinnest allocation on the page: nine events, and the sector is only obliged to place one of them. {{ENGI_STATION_DISTRESS}} is the one event that sits in two of this sector's pools, so it can turn up here or on a neutral beacon.
section_notes.ITEMS_ENGI: Three beacons of Engi generosity off a six-event list. {{ENGI_GIFT}} is a reward with no choice attached at all, {{ENGI_SURRENDER}} is an Engi ship handing over goods because you looked armed, and {{ENGI_FLEET_DELAY}} sells two missiles for two jumps of fleet delay.
section_notes.QUESTS_ENGI: Exactly one beacon from four candidates — but six events in the sector can plant a quest marker, {{CIVILIAN_ASTEROIDS_BEACON}} and {{ENGI_STATION_DISTRESS}} doing it from outside this list. {{MERCHANT_REQUEST}} is the widest event on the page: it pays five drone parts up front, and its other half can leave you with a traitor aboard and three to four boarders.

steps.title: Three ways to get the marker
steps.detail: {{FEDERATION_PLANET_SIGNAL}} on the quest beacon, {{CIVILIAN_ASTEROIDS_BEACON}} on a distress call, or {{ENGI_STATION_DISTRESS}} through the **Engi crew** blue option — on that one the blue option is the only branch that plants anything.

steps.title: The signal is a five-way draw
steps.detail: Investigating the federation signal draws one of five: the base marker, a different marker plus supplies, nothing, a high reward, or a Rebel ship with two to three human boarders already inside you.

steps.title: The marked beacon
steps.detail: Also a five-way draw — a high drone reward, a free crew member, 35 hull repaired, a cache that pays more with Sensors or Long-Ranged Scanners, or an automated Federation defender that opens fire on you.

items.text: The virus, the smashed ships, the Mantis-held station and the defence satellite. It is the only way to get the base marker out of {{ENGI_STATION_DISTRESS}}, and on {{ENGI_VIRUS}} it is the branch that gets a crewman killed.

Three graded outs inside {{ENGI_VIRUS}} — quarantine it, or reprogram it for 15 hull and a reactor bar, or 30 hull at level 3, all three ending with the augment. Also the only alternative to crippled engines in {{PIRATE_NO_ESCAPE}}.

The widest gate in the sector. Level 2 tells you what is aboard the burning station in {{DISTRESS_ENGI_REACTOR}} before you commit, which turns its coin-flip into a clean crew pickup; level 2 or 3 also opens {{WRECKAGE_EVENT}}, {{BROKEN_REBEL_DRONE}} and {{ENGI_STATION_DISTRESS}}.
All three events that can plant the hidden-base marker — {{FEDERATION_PLANET_SIGNAL}}, {{CIVILIAN_ASTEROIDS_BEACON}} and {{ENGI_STATION_DISTRESS}} — plus {{DISTRESS_ENGI_REACTOR}}.
Ways out of {{MANTIS_FIGHT_CHOICE}}, the storage station in {{AUTO_DEFENSE_ITEM}} and the satellite in {{DISTRESS_SATELLITE_DEFENSE}}, which grades its payoff by cloak level.
One clean solve on {{ENGI_VIRUS}} — scrap and the augment, no fight and nobody lost.

**Damaged Stasis Pod** from {{ASTEROID_DERELICT_SHIP}} — the Crystal route starts here, and there is no fight anywhere under it. Searching plainly costs 4 hull and an engine hit; **Rock Plating** searches for free.
A **Crystal crew member** at {{ZOLTAN_CREW_STUDY}}, if you arrive already carrying the pod.
**Engi Med-bot Dispersal** from {{DISTRESS_ENGI_REBEL}} for 40 scrap, 2 missiles and 2 fuel; the **Healing Burst** bomb is one of three draws off the cheaper 25-scrap option.
**Drone Reactor Booster** from {{ENGI_VIRUS}} — every Hacking and Lanius branch hands it over.
An **Engi with two levels in every skill**: take the Engi option on {{ENGI_VIRUS}}, lose the crewman to the virus, win the fight, and it walks back out.
{{ENGI_GIFT}} and {{ENGI_SURRENDER}} are free standard rewards with nothing asked in return — two of the six events on the three Engi item beacons.
Five events can cost you a crew member: {{DISTRESS_INFESTATION}}, {{DISTRESS_ENGI_REACTOR}}, {{CONFUSED_MANTIS}}, {{MERCHANT_REQUEST}}, and the Engi branch of {{ENGI_VIRUS}}.

Six events put someone aboard — up to four at {{FUELING_STATION}}, three to four at {{MERCHANT_REQUEST}}, two at {{ZOLTAN_CREW_STUDY}}, Mantis from {{ENGI_STATION_DISTRESS}} and {{ALISON_MANTIS_CREW}}, two to three humans on one draw of {{FEDERATION_PLANET_SIGNAL}}.
{{ENGI_VIRUS}} halves your shields **and** engines before the fight if you try to purge it yourself, and {{PIRATE_NO_ESCAPE}} holds engines at one bar until the pirate is dead.

{{SQUAT_WARNING}} is a fight with no choice attached, and letting the scout jump away costs a jump of your lead. {{PIRATE_BRIBER}} can buy one back, but only on the branch where you fight the pirate and the victim turns out to be a Rebel scout.
